userStories.technicalNotes: This story does not add new product code -- it is the wrap-up gate. For the architecture self-checks, use the existing tests/architecture/*.test.ts suite as a first pass (dependency-direction.test.ts, dependency-inversion.test.ts, domain-purity.test.ts, no-circular-deps.test.ts, port-segregation.test.ts, use-case-coverage.test.ts, entity-coverage.test.ts, single-responsibility.test.ts all already run as part of pnpm test) but note per the exploration that there is NO automated architecture test for 'actorId must come from session, not client' or 'every admin write calls recordAuditLog' -- these two must be verified by manual code reading across every file touched in US-002/US-004/US-005/US-008, since CI will not catch a regression here.
